  15. Monitorar mensalmente a performance de todos os modelos estatísticos de gerenciamento de risco das operações da Caedu.
  16. Constituir provisões para clientes individuais de acordo com a política da Caedu.
  17. Monitorar rentabilidade baseado nos modelos estatísticos de gerenciamento de risco e propor alterações de pricing das operações.

title: COORDENADOR DE ENFERMAGEM - UPA
description:
Job description

As Unidade de Pronto Atendimento são definidas como estabelecimentos de saúde de complexidade intermediária entre as Unidades Básicas de Saúde/Estratégia Saúde da Família (UBS/ESF) e a Rede Hospitalar, devendo compor, junto com estas, uma rede organizada de atenção às urgências, em conformidade com as diretrizes da Política Nacional de Atenção às Urgências.

As UPAs funcionam 24 horas e prestam atendimento médico de urgência e emergência, adulto e pediátrico, com a possibilidade de inserção de outras especialidades médicas como Ortopedia conforme a necessidade da região.

O atendimento é feito a partir do Acolhimento com Classificação de Risco, que estabelece as prioridades de tempo para o atendimento médico conforme a gravidade do paciente. Além disso, o serviço oferece leitos para observação, realização de procedimentos como exames laboratoriais de urgência, exames de imagem, suturas, inalação, administração de medicamentos e, caso necessário, encaminha os pacientes de maior gravidade, após estabilização, ao Hospital de Referência.


Main responsibilities

  1. Promover a gestão da equipe, padronizar e melhorar procedimentos da área de enfermagem e adaptar o sistema de atendimento à demanda exigida, de acordo com escalas de serviços estabelecidas, garantindo o bom cumprimento das disposições legais e éticas no exercício profissional da enfermagem.
  2. Atuar em conjunto com outros setores no desenvolvimento de ações conjuntas visando à realização de atividades, zelando pela integração e homogeneidade de atuação das áreas em cumprimento à demanda.
  3. Desenvolver em conjunto com a Gerência, estratégias estruturais para a melhoria de processos da área avaliando a necessidade de implantação de novos sistemas de trabalho, revisão de padrões técnicos, bem como, mudanças na metodologia de operação e conduta dos profissionais, zelando sempre pela eficiência da área frente às necessidades da Unidade.
  4. Cumprir e disseminar normas e diretrizes da Instituição e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde, Conselhos Regional e Federal de Enfermagem, bem como órgãos reguladores e fiscalizadores.
  5. Reportar à Gerência a identificação de necessidades, ações e processos em andamento, bem como o desempenho das atividades dos setores sob sua coordenação.
  6. Acompanhar e efetuar a avaliação das equipes sob sua responsabilidade, de acordo com a legislação e orientações da Instituição.
  7. Monitorar as rotinas e resultados das áreas sob sua subordinação.
  8. Propor e realizar treinamentos técnicos e específicos à sua área de atuação.
  9. Monitorar os processos de qualidade dentro da área coordenada.
  10. Acompanhar e avaliar periodicamente a atuação e entrega de serviços dos prestadores atuantes na Unidade.
  11. Gerir as Comissões de Enfermagem e as Comissões Multidisciplinares.
  12. Gerar, analisar e divulgar indicadores de desempenho e qualidade, emitir parecer sobre assuntos relacionados.
  13. Efetuar auditorias periódicas aos registros de enfermagem.
  14. Fornecer e avaliar relatórios e documentações sempre que solicitado.
  15. Reportar tecnicamente a (s) área (s) responsável (eis) no Corporativo, quanto à estruturação dos planos de trabalhos, resultados e indicadores de desempenho.
  16. Atuar tecnicamente quando for necessária sua contribuição na assistência.
  17. Orientar equipe de enfermagem quanto a necessidade de atualização do SISREG.
  18. Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM.
  19. Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
  20. Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Requirements and skills

  1. Ensino Superior completo em Enfermagem.
  2. Pós-graduação completa em Gestão Hospitalar, Gestão em Saúde, Gestão de Pessoas, Administração Hospitalar e áreas afins.
  3. Conselho ativo no COREN-SP.
  4. Curso de Protocolo de Classificação de Risco Manchester (Reconhecido pelo Grupo Brasileiro de Classificação de Risco).
  5. Experiência de seis meses em cargo de gestão em Enfermagem.

Additional information

Local de Trabalho: UPA

Região: Zona Sudeste

Horário de Trabalho: 08:00 - 17:00 segunda-feira à sexta-feira com 1 hora para refeição.

title: Ação policial em Alagoinhas apreende veículo clonado e prende suspeito armado
description:
Ação policial em Alagoinhas apreende veículo clonado e prende suspeito armado

Policiais do 4° BPM, em operação conjunta com o CICOM, prendem suspeito em flagrante com drogas e arma de fogo

Por: Redação

Compartilhe:

Foto: Divulgação/Quarto Batalhão

Na noite deste sábado (28), policiais do 4° Batalhão de Polícia Militar (BPM), durante a execução da Operação Falcão, foram acionados pelo Centro Integrado de Comunicações (CICOM) para verificar a denúncia de um veículo clonado identificado por câmeras de monitoramento na cidade de Alagoinhas. A guarnição iniciou buscas para localizar o Volkswagen Fox de cor preta, e, após algumas rondas, localizou o veículo na praça do Condomínio Linha Verde.

Durante a abordagem, a polícia realizou uma busca pessoal no condutor e também no veículo, encontrando diversos materiais ilícitos. Foram apreendidos um revólver calibre .28 com seis munições, uma porção de substância análoga à cocaína, três trouxinhas de substância análoga à maconha, além de uma ferramenta geralmente utilizada em arrombamentos de veículos.

Suspeito preso em flagrante é apresentado à Delegacia Territorial de Alagoinhas

Diante das evidências, o suspeito foi detido e, juntamente com o material apreendido e o veículo de placa clonada, conduzido à Delegacia Territorial de Alagoinhas. No local, foi lavrado o Auto de Prisão em Flagrante Delito, reforçando o sucesso da operação em combater o crime na região.

A operação segue como parte dos esforços contínuos da Polícia Militar da Bahia para garantir a segurança e a tranquilidade da população de Alagoinhas, intensificando o monitoramento e a repressão ao crime organizado.

* O conteúdo de cada comentário é de responsabilidade de quem realizá-lo. Nos reservamos ao direito de reprovar ou eliminar comentários em desacordo com o propósito do site ou que contenham palavras ofensivas. 500 caracteres restantes. Comentar

Alagoinhas é um município brasileiro do estado da Bahia, localizado no Agreste deste estado. Sua área é de 718,089 quilômetros quadrados e sua população em 2020 era de 152 327 habitantes, tendo portanto uma densidade demográfica de 210,05 habitantes por quilômetro quadrado

title: Senior Graphic Designer, BR
description:
The Opportunity:

Are you a creative designer with a keen eye for detail and a genuine interest in diving deeper into the gaming industry? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, team-focused environment where you can expand your design expertise and make a meaningful impact? If so, you could be a great fit for the Senior Graphic Designer, BR role we currently have available at Team Liquid.

As a Senior Graphic Designer, BR , you will play an important role in shaping the creative direction at Team Liquid. This position involves developing, managing, and executing high-impact visual assets across multiple platforms. A core aspect of this role is encouraging a feedback-focused environment, ensuring design consistency, and guiding junior designers. You will contribute to the evolution of design systems, while working closely with internal teams, including marketing and content.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Develop and execute high-impact visual concepts and campaigns across multiple platforms, from ideation to final delivery.
  • Ensure all designs align with Team Liquid's visual identity and brand guidelines. Create innovative assets in both static and motion that elevate brand storytelling and impact.
  • Maintain and evolve Team Liquid's brand guidelines, ensuring consistency across all creative outputs.
  • Help update design systems, including branding and style guides, to guide scalability.
  • Contribute to refining design systems, including but not limited to brand and motion design to enhance visual storytelling.
  • Experiment with new tools, techniques, and trends to push creative boundaries.
  • Work with marketing, content, and creative teams to align design work with broader strategic goals.
  • Act as a design stakeholder in various campaigns, working closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Guide and mentor junior designers, offering constructive feedback and assisting with their growth. Conduct design reviews, offering direction and mentorship to junior designers.
  • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, ensuring all timelines, deliverables, and quality standards are met.
  • Oversee the project lifecycle from conceptualization to execution, handling all aspects of design.
  • Identify areas for improvement in creative workflows, tools, and techniques to optimize design output and efficiency.
  • Introduce innovative approaches to creative processes to enhance continuous improvement.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of experience using Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Figma, and motion graphics.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Extensive knowledge of design concepts, typography, and photo retouching.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Proven experience guiding junior designers through the creative process.
  • In-depth knowledge of current design trends, especially in esports, gaming, and the entertainment industry.
  • Fluent in English.

You'll Earn Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Interest in gaining deeper insights into esports and gaming culture, and alignment with Team Liquid’s brand.
  • Interest in Web3 and related technologies.
  • Experience with UI/UX design and 3D modeling.
  • Proficiency in Blender, Cinema4D, or similar tools for creating 3D assets.
  • Awareness of digital item design trends (e.g., in-game skins).

This is a position with a PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) type of contract.

title: Data Center and Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Data Center and Infrastructure Engineer role at Blackfluo.ai

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Data Center and Infrastructure Engineer role at Blackfluo.ai

  • Location: Fully remote, Central Europe Time Zone
  • Languages: English is mandatory

Job Description:

  • Location: Fully remote, Central Europe Time Zone
  • Start date: To be defined
  • Languages: English is mandatory

The job involves providing technical support capacity to data center facilities and infrastructure globally. The candidate will help manage and maintain data center environments and assist with infrastructure configuration, and troubleshoot technical issues related to equipment and systems. Additionally, the incumbent will contribute to executing data center projects, including upgrades, migrations, and new deployments.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Center support and Infrastructure Engineer

  • Leading major data center strategy and implementations, including architecture, design and major migrations
  • Advising on Data Center best practices, governance, and compliance standards.
  • Defining and optimizing Global data center operations including sustainability initiatives
  • Engaging with senior stakeholders to align technical strategies with business goals.
  • Represent the organization in discussions with vendors or external stakeholders on technical matters.
  • Note: Engineer role is not expected to perform some technician level tasks.

Data Center support:

  • Support the onsite data center and facilities including cabling of both data and power connections as well as maintain the Data Center ancillaries inside the rack (patching)
  • Perform physical installation and de-installation of equipment, management and maintenance of cabling plant both fibre and copper, racks, PDUs; perform standard maintenance tasks and work instructions as per documented procedures
  • Maintain the data center environmental conditions such as heating and cooling systems to ensure they are operational and can meet equipment temperature conditions

Infrastructure support:

  • Participate in the installation and configuration of the infrastructure equipment, server hardware and network using the standard configuration and template as well as the resolution (incident and problem) of infrastructure related issues and requests
  • Participate in the documentation and reporting for infrastructure operations as well as maintain accurate system configuration such as Asset Management, tools and physical inventory and any other documentations as required
  • Maintain the housekeeping and stock management of materials and supplies (cables, parts, tools, etc.)
  • Keep up to date documentation and inventory of equipment, tools, asset management (cabling layout, equipment layout, etc.)
  • Liaise with UNICC technical teams and external providers on support activities, equipment deliveries and inventory, receive and inspect with vendors including escorting visits to the Data Center
  • Other: The incumbent may be requested to provide support during weekends, holidays or outside working hours and serve as stand-by personnel on a rotation basis

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Relevant IT work experience in supporting and/or operating enterprise data center environments and related services in a complex, heterogeneous environment.
  • Expertise in data center standards i.e. ANSI/TIA/BICSI and best practices as well as environmental controls.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Data Center Infrastructure Operations and understanding of DC components such as HVAC, racks, connectivity, power, and structured cabling.
  • Good knowledge of Data Center hardware (servers, network devices, backup hardware).
  • Knowledge of cable testing procedures and equipment for copper and fibre optic cabling systems.
  • Familiarity with configuring network equipment such as Cisco switches, network protocols e.g., TCP/IP, and virtualization technologies.
  • Experience in automation, API management, DCIM tools, and basic Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripting is an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of ISO2000 Service Management Standards and other service management standards.
  • Ability to read blueprints and technical documentation.
  • Good knowledge of Data Center and network management tools.

Education and Certifications:

  • Technical degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Data Center, Dell, HP, Cisco, ITIL, ISO) are highly desirable.

title: R&D Prod Dev Assoc Manager
description:
Overview

We Are PepsiCo . Join PepsiCo and Dare for Better! We are the perfect place for curious people, thinkers, and change agents. From leadership to front lines, we're excited about the future and working together to make the world a better place.

Being part of PepsiCo means being part of one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with our iconic brands consumed more than a billion times a day in more than 200 countries.

In Brazil since 1953, PepsiCo has well-known brands such as QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI, GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI, among others.

A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where all people are welcome. Here, you can dare to be you. No matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love, you can always influence the people around you and make a positive impact in the world. Know more: PepsiCoJobs Join PepsiCo, dare for better.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

PepsiCo is a global food and beverage leader operating in more than 200 countries and territories with a product portfolio that includes 22 world-famous, billion-dollar brands. From Beverages to Snacks, we make hundreds of enjoyable foods and beverages that are loved throughout the world.

Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to be the global leader in convenient foods and beverages by Winning with Purpose. “Winning with Purpose” reflects our ambition to win sustainably in the marketplace and embed purpose into all aspects of the business.

You will be responsible for translating consumer needs into product requirements & technical parameters to launch delicious and nourishing products for CARICAM and South Cone. We are looking for a hands-on food product developer that has a passion for food science and is both, highly creative and technically oriented.

Our employees drive our culture. No two days are the same; we’re dynamic and full of passionate teams embracing new ideas through our collaborative spirit. At PepsiCo, what makes you unique, makes us better!

Its impact

  • Lead Innovation, TBS, Productivity and portfolio transformation agenda for grains category for CARICAM & South Cone and build the future of the platform to deliver growth and SOM through close working and partnership with R&D disciplines and business and SC teams to ensure a robust, safe and legal product design. Validate economic evaluations on ingredients, suppliers, and formulations.
  • Effectively manage multiple projects and project types, develop work streams, define resource needs, and drive alignment. Build and Track R&D budget.
  • Design and execute experiments. Analyze and interpret data to make sound technical recommendations on product and process issues.
  • Coordinate production at bench top, pilot plant, and manufacturing levels for shelf life, stability, sales samples, scale-up, and other needs. Guide Product formulations development that leverages expertise in food chemistry and food ingredient functionality.
  • The role involves managing priorities within direct team and across multiple commercial and business stakeholders leveraging expertise inside and outside the organization to deliver against commercial plans.
  • Support cross functional teams through Stage Gate process from Feasibility to Execution while ensuring a robust product & process design and support technical and business risk assessment/perspectives.
  • Project Management - Develop and execute complex projects utilizing technical project management tools and skills to ensure objectives are accomplished on time, to the agreed standards and within budget.
  • Clearly articulating and aligning technical development needs to influence the wider R&D organization to develop the correct future fit solutions.
  • Proactively challenging the suitability and performance of product designs to maintain a competitive advantage in terms of product acceptance, unique product design, cost of goods etc.
  • Heavy interaction and direct engagement with Contract Manufacturing & Ingredient Suppliers.
  • Actively participate in Marketing, Consumer Insights and Sensory and Consumer Experience Research to ensure data driven product design.
  • Proactively progress the Pep+ agenda from all aspects of our targets.
  • Support talent development by providing guidance and oversight to team members and maintain focus on people growth.
  • Represent R&D on multi-functional business teams comprised of individuals from a variety of disciplines, including Marketing, Purchasing, Engineering, and other groups.
  • Travel ~20%

Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?

  • BSc in food engineering, material science, food/dairy science, chemistry or other related disciplines; >5 years’ experience with a Company Packaged Goods company with min 3 years in Research and Development.
  • Deep knowledge of ingredient function, formulation, mass balances -Process development – Knowledge of grain-based products; oatmeal, ready to eat cereal, pancake mix, baked products.
  • Project Management – experience managing technical projects for several complexities, setting up the agenda and building timelines to meeting deadlines.
  • Strong working knowledge of experimental design & product development protocols (from concept to execution), including formulation, stability testing, product/package interaction, and sensory and consumer testing methodology.
  • Detail oriented scientist who can manage and partner across R&D functions during product development life cycles that include new idea generation, prototype development, product optimization, production start-up and national launching of new product.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, think with empathy, and goal oriented.
  • Proven analytical skills to interpret complex data and translate into meaningful information e.g. interpreting consumer insights, experimental design and statistical inference and ability to disseminate to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Influence others through strong communication & interpersonal skills and outstanding teamwork.
  • Demonstrated ability to function effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment as well as manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Adapts to change, flexible to work in a high-performance and ever-changing environment. Demonstrates personal leadership to influence and positively motivate self and peers.
  • Strong organization, documentation, and Knowledge management skills.
  • Self-starter, self-motivating: able to balance competing priorities without losing momentum and manage uncertainty and complexity in fast evolving FMCG environments.
  • Strive for high standards, seek innovative solutions, drive continuous improvement of products and processes and demonstrates a high degree of intellectual curiosity.
  • Passion for creativity and innovation within a commercially driven environment.

If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
A Magnesium do Brasil é líder de negócios em pesquisa, beneficiamento e comercialização de magnesita. Com a visão de revelar o potencial do magnésio e tornar-se referência mundial no desenvolvimento, produção e comercialização de soluções de magnésio com qualidade, atuamos com portfólio de nutrição animal, massas refratárias e aplicações industriais. Pertencemos ao Groupe Roullier, que movido por uma energia coletiva, atua internacionalmente há mais de 60 anos em 8 áreas de atividade (Indústria Alimentar, Agrosupply, Fosfatos Alimentares, Magnésio, Nutrição Vegetal para o Público em Geral, Embalagem, Algologia e Energias Renováveis).

Todos os nossos funcionários incorporam nossos valores diariamente: Espírito de Equipe, Segurança, Desenvolvimento, Responsabilidade e Inovação. Comprometida com o desenvolvimento e a melhoria contínua, a Magnesium do Brasil está em constante evolução, colocando a experiência dos seus colaboradores no centro de todas as suas preocupações de gestão.

Nessa função, você terá a oportunidade de:

Desempenhar um papel crucial na proteção da saúde e segurança dos trabalhadores. Terá a chance de aplicar seus conhecimentos e habilidades para identificar e mitigar os riscos de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável. Além disso, você poderá colaborar com diversas áreas da empresa, trabalhando em equipe para implementar políticas e procedimentos eficazes de segurança. Nessa posição, você fará parte do nosso time industrial em nossa fábrica em Jucás - CE, reportando-se à Coordenação de Segurança.

Você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver programas de segurança específicos para ambientes industriais e de mineração, levando em consideração os riscos particulares associados a esses setores.
  • Conduzir auditorias de segurança para garantir a conformidade contínua com as regulamentações e os padrões de segurança.
  • Identificar e avaliar novas tecnologias e práticas de segurança que possam melhorar a eficácia dos programas de segurança no local de trabalho.
  • Investigar as ocorrências de segurança, analisando a causa raiz e definindo em conjunto com as áreas responsáveis, ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Apoiar na coordenação de equipes de resposta a emergências e a comunicação com as partes interessadas internas e externas.
  • Analisar dados relacionados à segurança e usar essas informações para tomar decisões informadas sobre melhorias nos programas de segurança.

Para ter sucesso nessa função, você deverá ter:

  • Nível Técnico em Segurança do trabalho.
  • Experiência na elaboração de Permissões de Trabalho e Análise Preliminar de Riscos.
  • Experiência em ministrar treinamentos regulatórios.
  • Experiência em análise de acidentes e incidentes, capacidade de identificar a causa raiz e atuar em conjunto com as áreas a preparação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Experiência com análise de dados, estatísticas e que tenha afinidade com planilhas, apresentações e a criação de documentos como procedimentos, manuais, instruções de trabalho, dentre outros.
  • Experiência em lidar com equipamentos de segurança específicos da indústria, como EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e sistemas de monitoramento de segurança.

Um ambiente cheio de desafios, com oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento. Nossa fábrica possui um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso e alegre, resultado da nossa cultura.

Por que juntar-se a nós?

Juntar-se a nós é atrever-se a fazer a diferença, a tomar iniciativas, a saber transformar dificuldades em oportunidades e a colocar o seu talento ao serviço de um coletivo, de uma ambição partilhada: Crescer Juntos é caminhar juntos na mesma direção.

Fundada em 1905, a Magnesium do Brasil foi 100% adquirida pelo Grupo Roullier em 2021 – multinacional francesa com faturamento anual superior a 4 bilhões de Euros, mais de 10.400 colaboradores e presente em todos os continentes.
Da extração ao tratamento da matéria-prima e com grandes esforços empesquisa e desenvolvimento, a Magnesium do Brasil tem por missão revelar opotencial do magnésio e tornar-se referência global nos mercados de nutriçãoanimal, fertilizantes, aplicações refratárias e outras aplicações industriais.

Mid-Level Android Engineer

São Paulo-SP, Brazil or Porto Alegre-RS, Brazil

Who We Are

In 2021, Poatek was acquired by WillowTree, an award-winning digital product consultancy recognized as one of the fastest growing and best places to work in the United States. Now a TELUS International company , with offices across the globe, we continue to partner with the world’s leading brands, such as the NBA, Capital One, HBO, PepsiCo, Domino’s and more, to design, build, and transform their digital products and strategies. We’re looking to grow our Poatek offices in Brazil with top talent excited to collaborate with team members across the globe to deliver innovative solutions for our clients.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role, which we’ve termed Work from Near (WFN). This model requires the ability to work on-site from our São Paulo - SP or Porto Alegre - RS office throughout the week based on team needs, while still providing the flexibility to work remotely on other days. Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

Poatek is seeking an experienced and passionate mid-level Android Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Android development and be excited about working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. Our mission is to create innovative and robust mobile applications that delight and inspire our users, and we need someone who can help us achieve that goal.

Responsibilities

  1. Develop, enhance, and maintain high-quality, scalable, and robust Android applications.
  2. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (including program managers, designers, and other engineers) to design, build, and ship new features and improvements.
  3. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code in Kotlin and Java, following best practices and coding standards.
  4. Troubleshoot and resolve software defects, ensuring that applications perform optimally across various Android devices and OS versions.
  5. Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality code and adherence to coding standards.
  6. Stay up-to-date with the latest Android development tools, technologies, and best practices.
  7. Assist in estimating, prioritizing, planning, and coordinating development activities.
  8. Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies.
  9. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior team members when needed.

Qualifications

  1. 4+ years of experience building large, complex Android applications
  2. Expertise in Kotlin and Java programming languages.
  3. Strong understanding of Android SDK, Android Studio, and related development tools.
  4. Familiarity with modern Android architecture patterns, such as MVVM, MVP, or MVI.
  5. Experience with Android frameworks, such as Jetpack, Dagger, Retrofit, and RxJava.
  6. Proficient in working with RESTful APIs, JSON, and XML data formats.
  7. Experience in implementing custom layouts and UI designs and optimizing UX for various screen sizes and resolutions.
  8. Familiarity with agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban.
  9. Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices.
  10. Experience with unit testing, UI testing, and test-driven development.
  11. Knowledge of version control systems, such as Git.
  12. Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
  13. Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

Why Poatek?

What We Offer:

  1. Be part of an innovative consultancy with a human-centered culture with opportunities for ownership and professional growth.
  2. Competitive salary and benefits package (annual bonus).
  3. Opportunity to work on innovative agile projects with other high-performing, passionate team members from all over the globe (international travel opportunities).
  4. Collaborative work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development (including English classes, support in national and international courses).
  5. Flexible work hours and autonomy.
  6. Voucher for health activities, food allowance, in-office snacks, drinks, and games.

If you love IT as much as we do, we look forward to meeting you!

Equality is a principle here at Poatek. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O time de Interaction Platform:

O time de Interaction Platform tem o propósito de facilitar o desenvolvimento de experiências multiplataforma com alta qualidade e eficiência, reduzindo os custos e o tempo que levamos para evoluir os produtos e melhorar a experiência de nossos(as) clientes.

Nossa responsabilidade é construir plataformas (Ex: mobile, web, terminais, conversacionais) e os padrões de experiência globais através do design system, viabilizando a criação de funcionalidades de forma única, padronizada e com mais agilidade, permitindo que os demais times da Stone consigam evoluir as soluções de forma eficiente e evitando a necessidade de aumentar nossos custos de operação ao desenvolver inúmeras vezes uma mesma aplicação para atender diferentes consumidores.

Como é ser uma pessoa Software Engineer Mobile Sr.

Você terá um papel de grande influência técnica no time, com a missão de compartilhar conhecimentos em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, familiarizado(a) com testes unitários, automatizados, e oferecendo suporte às pessoas desenvolvedoras do time.

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento, que irá apoiar na evolução da régua técnica do time, com atuação "hands on" onde precisará mergulhar no código e se aproximar bastante das soluções técnicas, atuará no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e melhoria do contexto de plataforma mobile na Stone.

Atuará de forma "cross" em grandes projetos junto ao time de Interaction Platform, ajudando a realizar o movimento de plataformização na companhia, além da adoção de boas práticas no desenvolvimento de mobile.

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Android, incluindo Kotlin e Jetpack Compose;
  • Experiência em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, adotando padrões de codificação consistentes e bem documentados;
  • Experiência em investigação, troubleshooting e depuração de sistemas.
  • Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, serviços em nuvem (por exemplo, Firebase), armazenamento local e remoto de dados, autenticação e notificações push;
  • Conhecimentos sobre estrutura de CI/CD, pipeline automatizado;
  • Conhecimentos de arquitetura de módulos e componentização;
  • Conhecimentos sobre Testes unitários, testes de integração, testes funcionais e testes de snapshots, utilizando ferramentas como JUnit, Espresso, Mockito, XCTest, Snapshot Testing, entre outras;
  • Publicação de apps (Play Store e/ou App Store);
  • Ferramentas de métricas e marketing (e.g. Firebase, Google Analytics, Amplitude);
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum ou Kanban.

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Familiaridade com gerenciadores de dependência (CocoaPods, Carthage, SPM), Fastlane;
  • Experiência em Android Studio e Gradle;
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento com React Native;
  • Contribuição em projetos Open Source;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Design System com compreensão dos princípios de design systems, incluindo componentização, padronização de UI/UX, uso de bibliotecas de componentes, diretrizes de design e padrões de interface;

Why the American University of Iraq – Baghdad?

Opening its doors in January of 2021, the new American University of Iraq – Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and the United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB will be a beautiful campus attracting students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

This position will report directly to the Associate Director of Wellness Center.

Job Purpose

The Student Mental Health Counselor provides counseling services and programming designed to help students in the AUIB learning community improve their emotional wellbeing and develop the personal skills needed for successful university life. Services include crisis intervention, problem-solving, evidence-based psychotherapy and mental health counseling, psychological assessment, psychiatric referrals, and education and prevention programs. This newly created position will be a key player in ensuring that the AUIB Wellness Center is accessible for students in the upcoming spring 2024 semester and that students will have access to the mental health services that they need. The Wellness Center will initially have a primary focus on the offering of counseling and psychological services but will also offer student accessibility services as well as act as a campus safety center where students will be able to report their concerns, seek emergency help, or go for crisis intervention.

Areas of Accountabilities: Main Activities

  • Providing clinical services (intake, individual, group, and emergency/crisis counseling, and individual assessment), outreach and consultation services, training, light administrative duties.
  • Maintaining an active caseload of weekly counseling clients, for students.
  • Providing an ongoing program of personal, substance use, psychological, crisis intervention, and other types of counseling services to the students.
  • Accepting referrals from staff and faculty for students suspected of experiencing emotional, psychological, or personal difficulties.
  • Collaborating with faculty, staff, and/or University offices (HR and line managers) to support employee wellbeing.
  • Providing input for professional staff development programs for the Departments of Student Life and Student Services, and other University divisions or departments.
  • Assisting in developing and facilitating wellness programming for residence halls and First-Year Experience classes on relevant topics as needed. Topics may include substance abuse, sexuality, relationships, depression, and stress management.
  • Assisting in designing and coordinating programs for faculty and staff on identifying and dealing with students struggling with substance abuse, depression, hostility, family problems, etc.
  • Assisting in the coordination of care for students who are receiving mental health treatment off-campus.
  • Designing and conducting special interest counseling groups as needed focusing on mental health needs of the student population (e.g., substance use, relationship issues, sexual assault, academic pressures, etc.)
  • Preparing and maintaining treatment records, reports, and other required documentation while ensuring the confidentiality of all student information.
  • Providing programs and resources in support of AUIB-wide wellbeing initiatives.
  • Fulfilling other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

A: Educational Qualifications:

  • A Master’s degree in Clinical Mental Health Counseling or equivalent, full licensure by the relevant licensing authority for psychotherapy/counseling services.

B: Minimum Experience:

  • No less than 2-3 years of counseling experience.

C: Competencies (Knowledge, Skills & Abilities):

  • Additional licensure in clinical addictions counseling is preferred.
  • Evidence of the ability to work effectively and collegially in cross-functional teams.
  • Evidence of ability to participate in planning and participating in cross-functional collaboration regarding holistic student wellbeing.
  • Evidence of strategic thinking and leadership.
  • Ability to speak and work in both English and Arabic.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover Letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

University Background

The mission of California Lutheran University is to educate leaders for a global society who are strong in character and judgment, confident in their identity and vocation, and committed to service and justice. Founded in 1959 in beautiful Ventura County, the university has an enrollment of about 4,000 undergraduate and graduate students who come from across the nation and around the world from a diversity of backgrounds, cultures and faiths. As a federally recognized Hispanic-Serving Institution, Cal Lutheran is looking for candidates with a dedication to and success in working in diverse communities. The university is committed to an inclusive learning and work environment that values individual differences and respects each person’s dignity.

Basic Function

Under the direction of the Dean, Department Chair or Program Director, the Adjunct Faculty Member is responsible for providing academic instruction to students for the assigned graduate courses.

Representative Duties

Provide academic instruction to students through lecture, lab, or performance courses; assess and develop cognitive abilities, communication skills, and higher order thinking skills among students through appropriate assignments and activities in one-on-one, classroom, and distance mediated instructional settings. title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Join to apply for the Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you've enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.
The Canonical Kernel Team builds and maintains all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels for a variety of platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large-scale cloud environments. In your first year you will tackle serious initiatives, which include but are not limited to:

  • Optimized solutions for key Silicon and Cloud partner platforms
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics
  • Expanded driver support for bleeding-edge PC platforms
We select candidates that are recent university graduates or early career professionals who are enthusiastic to develop kernel-level software in multiple areas including security updates, patching, and testing. The successful candidate will have a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing and able to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.
These are full-time positions available to prospective or recently graduated students.
Location: We have home-based Kernel Teams in every timezone.
The role entails
  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers
What we are looking for in you
  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length
Nice-to-have skills
  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Overview

Nós somos KeminSomos visionários que veem as coisas de forma diferente e são inspirados pelo mundo que nos rodeia. Há mais de meio século que nos dedicamos a utilizar a ciência aplicada para melhorar a qualidade de vida.Somos um fabricante global de ingredientes que se esforça todos os dias para transformar de forma sustentável a qualidade de vida de 80% da população mundial com seus produtos e serviços.Por mais de meio século, a Kemin tem se dedicado a usar a ciência aplicada para enfrentar os desafios da indústria e oferecer soluções de produtos a clientes em mais de 120 países. A Kemin fornece ingredientes para alimentar uma população crescente com seu compromisso com a qualidade, segurança e eficácia de alimentos, rações e produtos relacionados à saúde para clientes em todo o mundo.Fundada em 1961, a Kemin é uma empresa privada, de propriedade e operação familiar, com mais de 2.800 funcionários globais e operações em 90 países, incluindo instalações de fabricação na Bélgica, Brasil, China, Índia, Itália, Rússia, San Marino, Cingapura, África do Sul e Estados Unidos.

O objetivo desta posição é assegurar que os processos da Kemin estejam dentro da legislação vigente, cumprindo com todas as obrigações pertinentes a Saúde, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho. Propor alternativas de melhorias de processos relacionados as áreas de sua responsabilidade, garantindo um ambiente seguro, confiável e de acordo com a legislação.

Responsibilities

  • Acompanhar a elaboração e a execução do PPRA – Programa de Prevenção e Riscos Ambientais e do LTCAT, avaliando os dados criteriosamente a fim de propor melhorias e adaptações de acordo com o negócio.
  • Acompanhar a elaboração e administrar o PCMSO – Programa de Controle e Medicina Ocupacional.
  • Administrar e acompanhar os Laudos Técnicos e Ergonômicos.
  • Propor melhorias e adequações relacionadas a ergonomia e segurança, visando um local seguro e confortável para os colaboradores.
  • Enviar os relatórios, registros e certificados obrigatórios aos Órgãos Públicos (Ministério do Trabalho, Sindicatos etc.).
  • Garantir e cobrar a utilização dos EPIs Equipamento de Proteção Individual e EPC´s (Equipamento de Proteção Coletiva) para os colaboradores e os departamentos, controlando a entrega e utilização, visando à redução dos riscos à segurança e integridade física do trabalhador.
  • Promover inspeções nos locais de trabalho, identificando condições perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como treinar e conscientizar os funcionários quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho.
  • Controlar e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, organizar a Brigada de Emergência, promover o treinamento de Abandono de Área, cumprindo a legislação.
  • Colaborar nos projetos de modificações prediais ou novas instalações da empresa, visando a criação de condições mais seguras no trabalho.
  • Pesquisar e analisar as causas de doenças ocupacionais e as condições ambientais em que ocorreram, tomando as providências exigidas em lei, evitando sua reincidência, bem como corrigir as condições insalubres causadoras dessas doenças.
  • Preparar programas de treinamentos técnicos sobre segurança do trabalho, incluindo programas de integração, conscientização e divulgação de normas de segurança, para o desenvolvimento de uma atitude preventiva quanto à segurança do trabalho.
  • Realizar a integração de Segurança de novos funcionários, bem como de prestadores de serviços.
  • Promover campanhas, palestras relacionadas com Saúde, Segurança e Qualidade de Vida no Trabalho e em Casa, com o objetivo de conscientizar o trabalhador.
  • Administrar, acompanhar e realizar o processo de renovação da CIPA em seus programas, estudando suas observações e proposições, visando adotar soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho.
  • Prestar apoio à SIPAT, organizando as atividades e recursos necessários.
  • Levantar e estudar os indicadores de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais e do trabalho, analisando suas causas e gravidade, adotando medidas preventivas.
  • Preparar e enviar o reporte das análises de acidente.
  • Avaliar os casos de acidente do trabalho, acompanhando o acidentado para recebimento de atendimento médico adequado.
  • Atuar de acordo com as normas, leis e procedimentos internos vigentes do departamento e da empresa.

Qualifications

  • Formação Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Desejável formação Técnica em Meio Ambiente.
  • Desejável superior completo ou cursando em Engenharia de Segurança.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Conhecimento das legislações vigentes (NR´s e legislação trabalhista).
  • Conhecimentos em PPRA, PCMSO, LTCAT e demais documentos obrigatórios.
  • Realização de palestras e treinamentos.
  • Análises técnicas de documentos.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no segundo turno (13h às 22h50).

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Hardware Engineer, you will play a critical role in the design, development, and optimization of our cutting-edge hardware components and systems. Your expertise will contribute to a new generation of devices, developing new features and products from scratch, selecting components, and layouting PCBs. Always guaranteeing the reliability, performance, standard compliance, and scalability of our IoT products, and enabling seamless monitoring and management of industrial assets.

Responsibilities

Take ownership of hardware design projects, including conceptualization, schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout.

Develop innovative and efficient hardware solutions that meet project requirements and specifications, following standards such as IEC 60079 (IECEx) and IEC 61010 (Electrical Safety).

Define and execute test plans to verify the performance, reliability, and compatibility of hardware designs.

Adapt the project and provide documentation for telecommunications standards and certifications such as FCC, IFT, CE and ANATEL.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as software engineering, firmware engineering, and product management, to ensure seamless integration and interoperability of hardware components.

Troubleshoot hardware-related issues by investigating and diagnosing problems, identifying root causes, and recommending appropriate solutions.

Document findings, test results, and hardware performance metrics in a clear and concise manner.

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field.

Minimum of 5 years of experience in hardware engineering and electronics.

Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB layout tools such as KiCAD and Altium Designer.

Experience utilizing laboratory equipment and tools for hardware testing, analysis and troubleshooting.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey complex technical information effectively.

Experience with design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA).

Familiarity with hardware design for low-power and battery-operated devices.

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Live or have availability to move to Sao Paulo.

Bonus Points

Knowledge of programming languages, such as C/C++ or Python, for test automation and data analysis purposes.

Strong understanding of Antenna Designing.

Strong understanding of Telecommunication Technologies.

Strong understanding of AC/DC and DC/DC converters.

Experience with Hazardous Locations Certifications (ATEX and IECEx).

Experience with Telecommunication Certifications (FCC, IFT, CE)

COMPENSATION

• Competitive salary and stock options

• Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses

• 30 days of paid annual leave

• Education and courses stipend

• Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years

• Day off during the week of your birthday

• R$200 a month for remote work allowance

• Mental health support: we cover 40% of the cost of your therapy

• Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation

• Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.

• Up to R$5.000 bonus for referring new Blue Caps

title: Applications Consultant SAP LES Transportation
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Como Consultor de Aplicações você atuará na condução funcional/ técnica de projetos para a implementação de aplicações na Gerdau, com foco em SAP, sistemas voltados para processos Logísticos e Interfaces com Sistemas Especialistas. Deverá executar atividades em projetos e aplicações envolvendo múltiplas tecnologias e plataformas (SAP, soluções logísticas e Interfaces). Coordenará as equipes de projeto de modo garantir agilidade e boas práticas de implementação de soluções (performance, estabilidade, escalabilidade, documentação) de acordo com as diretrizes da Gerdau para implementação. Participará da concepção (framing) e condução de iniciativas com foco no Roadmap Logístico.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar o portfólio de iniciativas SAP relacionadas aos processos Logísticos, isto é, do módulo SAP LES-TRA (movimentação de mercadorias, etapas de picking e packing, gestão de estoque e armazéns, programação de saídas de mercadoria, gerenciamento da contratação e custos de transporte);
  • Liderar e participar de projetos digitais logísticos voltados para a gestão e movimentação de estoques, gestão de filas e pátios e gerenciamento de transportes;
  • Ter olhar global sobre iniciativas relacionadas aos processos Logísticos, garantindo a convergência do uso de produtos e soluções;
  • Promover a arquitetura técnica definida e a observância aos processos internos da Global Tech Hub (estrutura de tecnologia da Gerdau);
  • Garantir a transição para operação (transtion-to-run) adequado, envolvendo todas as áreas da Global Tech Hub, Negócio e parceiros que deverão ter ciência e estabelecerem os padrões de cada área, para as iniciativas que participar;
  • Atuar sob demanda junto a área de operações provendo consultoria/suporte em situações emergências e de crise;
  • Atuar como facilitador do AMS para resolução de problemas em ambiente produtivo, e gestão de níveis de serviço dos fornecedores;
  • Interagir junto com os times da Digital Tech Hub (Arquitetura, Segurança da Informação, Value Factory, Data & AI, Devops, Infraestrutura e Tecnologia Local) no desenvolvimento e entrega das soluções;
  • Auxiliar o time de negócio na condução de melhorias dos sistemas legados;
  • Auxiliar usuários sobre os processos de desenvolvimento, manutenção e/ou contratação de novos serviços/melhorias de software.
  • Utilizar dos recursos de agilidade para implantação de melhorias/projetos de software.

Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento dos módulos SAP LES-TRA;
  • Conhecimento de SAP WM (Warehouse Management);
  • Conhecimento em processos logísticos: WMS, YMS e TMS;
  • Experiência em processo de implementação SAP S/4 HANA;
  • Conhecimento e participação em projetos SAP e Não SAP usando metodologias Ágeis e Waterfall;
  • Facilidade de trabalho em times com colaboração intensa;
  • Ter conhecimento em técnicas de inovação (ex: Design Thinking, Design Sprint);
  • Conhecimento sobre práticas de levantamento de requisitos;
  • Conhecimento dos principais padrões de desenvolvimento de sistemas e produtos digitais;
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas e desenvolvimentos de soluções;
  • Ter formação superior completa. (preferencial formação em Sistemas de Informação, Ciências da Computação, Eng. Computacional, Administração com ênfase em Sistemas de Informação ou equivalente);

Conhecimentos Desejáveis:

  • Módulo SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management);

  • Uso de EDI para em transações logísticas;
  • Conhecimento ou participação em iniciativas piloto de Inteligência Artificial em processos logísticos;

  • Plataformas Cloud, Devops e Big Data;

title: Learning & Development Manager
description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

Team Overview

The Learning and Development (L&D) plays a critical role in fostering employee growth, improving performance, and supporting organizational goals. It involves identifying skill gaps, designing and delivering training programs, and creating opportunities for continuous learning. L&D empowers employees to reach their full potential while helping the organization stay agile, competitive, and future-ready.

Role Responsibilities

  • The Learning & Development Manager is responsible for designing and implementing strategies to enhance employee growth, leadership development, and organizational capability.
  • This role involves assessing business needs, identifying skill gaps, and developing targeted learning programs that drive performance and career progression.
  • Lead the creation of comprehensive training frameworks, including leadership development, functional upskilling, and soft skills enhancement.
  • Additionally, they will collaborate with business leaders and HR partners to build a strong learning culture, leveraging data-driven insights to measure training effectiveness and continuously refine development initiatives.
  • This role requires a proactive approach to talent planning, coaching, and fostering an environment where employees are empowered to reach their full potential.

Role Qualifications

  • The Talent Development Expert requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, instructional design, and leadership development expertise.
  • 4-6 years of experience.
  • The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge of learning methodologies, adult learning principles, and training program design to create impactful development initiatives.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills are essential to assess training effectiveness and optimize programs.
  • Additionally, the role demands excellent stakeholder management and communication skills to collaborate with leaders, HR partners, and employees at all levels.
  • Expertise in coaching, facilitation, and change management is crucial to drive a continuous learning culture.
  • Adaptability, creativity, and a proactive approach to talent development will be key to success in this role.

EEO Statement

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Women, and 99Families.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

description:
Ei, quer fazer parte de algo grande? Curte a ideia de trabalhar em um lugar onde suas ideias são super bem-vindas e os desafios te fazem crescer todo dia?

Então, se liga: a SolarVolt pode ser o seu próximo passo! Somos a galera da energia solar, apaixonados por inovar e levar mais energia limpa para todo o Brasil. Somos uma das maiores empresas do segmento, primeira empresa a ser certificada com três selos nível máximo pela Absolar, e a maior integradora WEG de Minas Gerais.

Sabemos que a chave para o crescimento está numa equipe de alto desempenho, e por isso procuramos uma pessoa para ingressar como ANALISTA DE CUSTOS, para atuação em nosso escritório localizado em NOVA LIMA/MG.

Principais desafios do seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolvimento de Orçamentos Detalhados: Desenvolver orçamentos completos para projetos de construção, considerando todos os custos envolvidos, como mão de obra, materiais, equipamentos e despesas gerais.
  • Preparação de Relatórios Financeiros: Preparar relatórios regulares sobre o desempenho financeiro das obras, garantindo transparência no acompanhamento dos custos do projeto.
  • Elaboração de Relatórios Semanais de Obra: Produzir relatórios semanais contendo o cronograma atualizado, detalhando as ações realizadas e previstas, incluindo atividades e materiais utilizados.
  • Análise de Custos das Obras: Analisar detalhadamente os custos das obras, fornecendo relatórios que destacam os valores investidos e comparações com o orçamento inicial.
  • Monitoramento de Gastos e Desvios Orçamentários: Registrar e monitorar os gastos reais em relação ao orçamento, identificando desvios e explicando suas causas.
  • Desenvolvimento e Acompanhamento de Indicadores de Performance: Criar indicadores de desempenho (KPI's) para monitorar a execução da obra e acompanhar o desempenho das equipes em campo.
  • Execução de Atividades Correlatas: Realizar outras atividades relacionadas conforme determinação da chefia imediata.

O que você precisa ter para fazer parte deste time:

  • Formação Superior completa (Engenharia Civil e afins);
  • Experiência com planejamento e acompanhamento de obras;
  • CNH B e disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Pacote Office intermediário;

Ganhe pontos extras aqui:

  • Experiência com MSProject;

O que a SolarVolt oferece:

  • Vale Refeição ou alimentação - para ter energia

  • Confraternizações constantes e eventos de integração - para proporcionar novas amizades

Philadelphia Gear part of the Timken Power Systems group in Santa Fe Springs, CA has a current opening for aManufacturing Supervisor position. The position supervises teams of qualified Mechanical Assemblers and Welders, has the responsibility of providing direction and leadership for assigned manufacturing operations in achieving goals related to safety, quality, cost, and on time delivery of products while developing and maintaining effective working relationships with employees at all levels of the organization.

The position reports to the Operations Manager and is also responsible for manufacturing follow through.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supervise, coordinate, and maintain schedule on themanufacturing, assembly and rebuilding of gearboxes and related products in accordance with the priorities established by the Operations Manager.
  • Plan and monitor employee skill utilization, labor hours required, materials and workflow to insure timely delivery of products.
  • Organize and assign work and provide instruction to employees towards the attainment of manufacturing objectives. Establish efficient work hours and schedule overtime to meet manufacturing requirements as necessary.
  • Identify and report manufacturing issues and implement corrective actions. Assist in developing and implementing Continuous Improvement activities utilizing LEAN principles.
  • Coordinate manufacturing activities with functional area managers and supervisors (Quality, Engineering, Customer Service, Accounting, etc.) to meet or exceed delivery schedules and customer requirements.
  • Provide required training to all assigned manufacturing personnel in accordance with skill requirements for each position. Track and monitor training compliance across all assigned teams.
  • Ensure work force maintains compliance with all manufacturing, quality and safety rules and provide feedback on job performance.
  • Ensure the proper use of safety equipment. Continuously monitor all assigned work areas for hazardous conditions and unsafe practices.
  • Monitor all assigned work areas for good housekeeping practices, cleanliness and organization.
  • When requested, participate in the specification and justification for new equipment. Assist in cost analysis and benefits, as needed, to justify equipment purchase.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degreewith a minimum of 3years of industrial manufacturing experience preferably related to mechanical power transmissions or rotating equipment, or 8 years of experience with a high school education or equivalent.
  • Must have the ability to read and interpret mechanical and electrical drawings
  • Must have strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Key attributes include the ability to multi-task, set priorities, and meet deadlines with a high degree of accuracy. Must have the ability to lead and work as part of a team
  • Excellent computer skills (proficient in Microsoft Office software), strong written and verbal communication skills are required. LEAN experience is preferred
  • Working knowledge of ISO9001:2015 standards required
  • Must be a US citizen or a legally authorized foreign worker to work in ITAR environment.
