title: Estagio product owner processo seletivo continuo vaga hibrida
description:
PROCESSO SELETIVO CONTÍNUO

A dti está em constante crescimento e por isso alguns papeis possuem uma demanda contínua de novos profissionais, de diferentes perfis técnicos. Ao invés de publicarmos dezenas de vagas para essas posições, trabalhamos com uma vaga central, a Vaga mãe, onde você, ao se inscrever, estará disponível para receber convites para todos os contextos com vagas abertas na empresa. Essa é a fonte primária de busca por pessoas candidatas de nossas Tech Recruiters.
PROCURAMOS UMA PESSOA QUE:

  • Seja apaixonada por ouvir e compreender as necessidades do cliente, mapeando suas necessidades e propondo soluções incríveis;
  • Tenha habilidades de liderança, seja uma boa comunicadora e se relacione bem com as pessoas;
  • Seja focada em resultados e criativa;
  • Tenha muita vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a dti digital;
  • Seja proativa e capaz de tomar decisões de maneira autônoma;
  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe;
  • E que se identifique com a nossa cultura!

SERÁ SUA RESPONSABILIDADE:

  • Auxiliar no levantamento e escrita de processos de negócio, regras de negócio e requisitos em geral;
  • Apoiar na construção, manutenção e priorização do backlog;
  • Acompanhar diariamente as atividades junto ao cliente (Briefings, reuniões e apresentações de métricas e resultados);
  • Ser capaz de compreender e comunicar os objetivos comerciais e técnicos é crucial.

REQUISITOS BÁSICOS:

  • Cursando Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia de Sistemas, Engenharia Elétrica, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia de Produção, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou equivalentes;
  • Disponibilidade para fazer pelo menos 1 ano e meio de estágio;
  • Interesse em construir uma trajetória como Product Owner;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre a atuação do Product Owner em produtos digitais;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre gestão de Backlog;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre priorização de atividades;
  • Boa comunicação, habilidade de expressar ideias e desejo por se desenvolver em comunicação com clientes;
  • Ser organizado e bom no gerenciamento de tempo e tarefas;
  • Familiaridade com a metodologia ágil.

HABILIDADES QUE FARÃO VOCÊ SE DESTACAR:

  • Ter alguma experiência de atuação como Product Owner;
  • Conhecimentos sobre ferramentas de gerenciamento de requisitos e tarefas como o Azure DevOps Server, Jira, entre outros;
  • Conhecimentos mais avançados em metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre lógica de programação.

BENEFÍCIOS DE TRABALHAR COM A DTI:

  • Bolsa de estágio de R$ 1.200,00;
  • 30h semanais;
  • Horário flexível: conseguindo fazer as 6h de trabalho entre 8h e 19h;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale alimentação (R$890/mês);
  • Parceria com SESC para desconto em acomodações e atividades de lazer;
  • Desconto em cursos de inglês com a Open English;
  • Desconto MBA USP/ESALQ: cursos Essential e MBA (pós-graduação lato sensu) distância e presencial;
  • Parceria com a PUC-RS: 10% de desconto em Cursos de Graduação online, MBA e Especialização (online e presencial), Idiomas e Certificações;
  • Parceria com FIAP: é disponibilizado aos crafters e aos seus dependentes (cônjuges e filhos) bolsa de 10% de desconto sobre as parcelas de graduação e colégio (FIAP School e Módulo) e 20% no valor das mensalidades dos cursos de MBA, Pós Tech ou SHIFT, nos formatos presencial e on-line;
  • Descontos em Farmácias: Drogasil e Droga Raia;
  • Ambiente descontraído, flexível e com feedbacks constantes;
  • Rotina com aprendizado constante, com Tech Shots, Rodas de Conversa e Knowledge Transfers.

TRAJETÓRIA NA DTI

Na dti, o Plano de Carreira Ágil é uma jornada de crescimento contínuo, onde cada crafter tem a liberdade de traçar seu caminho, com o apoio de ferramentas e programas desenhados para inspirar e alinhar o desenvolvimento pessoal aos seus sonhos. O Trajetórias é a bússola que orienta esse percurso, sempre valorizando a autonomia e impulsionando conquistas extraordinárias.

IMPORTANTE! MODELO DE TRABALHO HÍBRIDO!

Hoje na dti atuamos com um tipo de modelo de trabalho chamado híbrido, que consiste em unir o melhor do trabalho remoto e do presencial. Dessa forma, é importante que nosso futuro crafter tenha a disponibilidade e a possibilidade de ir presencialmente até a sede da empresa, na cidade de Belo Horizonte, para reuniões, ritos, eventos etc, quando for necessário.

Sendo assim, se torna requisito básico para a vaga ser uma opção para o candidato vir presencialmente na sede da empresa quando for necessário.

Vale ressaltar que essa demanda de trabalho presencial é apenas quando necessário, sendo o modelo de trabalho mais utilizado pela empresa no dia a dia o trabalho remoto.

E aí, se identificou com a nossa cultura? Então corre para se inscrever.

Se o seu currículo for selecionado para a primeira fase do nosso processo seletivo, entraremos em contato, então fique atenta(o) ao seu e-mail (inclusive na pasta do spam) e telefone, ok? Caso seu currículo não seja triado, não enviamos feedback, mas você ficará no nosso banco de currículos e poderá se candidatar novamente em outro momento ;)

description:
Job Family: Maintenance

Location:

Rio de Janeiro, BR, 20021-290 Marly

About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy.

MAINTENANCE SUPERINTENDENT

Reports To: OIM

The Maintenance Superintendent will exhibit exemplary leadership, managerial and safety behaviors and will specifically ensure that all aspects of maintenance and condition monitoring activities are carried out effectively and efficiently.

Authority: The Maintenance Superintendent assumes responsibility for safety, financial, logistical and operational aspects of maintenance activities and is responsible for the competence of those under his immediate supervision.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITES

  1. Implementation of Management System
  2. Promote safety awareness and application of company Management System, COPs and prime policies.
  3. Report concisely in accordance with Management System requirements with due regard for document control.
  4. Ensure timely and effective closeout of survey and relevant audit actions.
  5. Ensure change management procedures are applied appropriately.
  6. Contribute effectively to incident investigation, review and reporting.

Personnel

  1. Manage the operation of the vessel systems at department level through supervisors and subordinate staff.
  2. Promote training and competency assurance throughout the Maintenance Department in line with Company goals for the Unit.
  3. Ensure probationary and annual appraisals are completed fairly and consistently in timely manner.
  4. Encourage and support Supervisors to achieve training and competency targets with particular regard to appropriate time allocation for this area of work.
  5. Manage welfare and disciplinary issues at departmental level with appropriate reference to OIM and Fleet HR.

Works

  1. Efficient operation of unit systems having due regard for Health and safety.
  2. Ensure full compliance with PTW system, and Risk assessment and verification.
  3. Ensure full compliance with Class, Flag and Port State requirements, preserving the vessel’s operational status.
  4. Effective supervision of project, subcontract and vendor personnel.
  5. Efficiency improvement and pursuance of company goals.
  6. Responsible for condition monitoring, maintenance, preservation and repair of vessel and process systems.
  7. Manage parts control, inventories storage record keeping, shipping and receiving by use of CMMS.

Contract

  1. Manage operations in conjunction with all department heads to maximize efficiency and uptime.
  2. Maintain effective cost control and promote cost awareness in others.
  3. Maintain awareness of key issues relating to client and sub-contractor relationships.

Emergency Response

  1. Demonstrate through exercises and drills, knowledge and awareness of emergency response techniques.
  2. Demonstrate knowledge of potential impact of incidents and scenarios on vessel safety and security.
  3. Contribute effectively to preparation of useful exercises and to post exercise/ incident review and investigation.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  1. Proven experience and results-oriented career AND/OR HND or Degree equivalents in appropriate engineering subject, or STCW III/2 Chief Engineer Officer on ships powered by main propulsion machinery of 3,000 kW propulsion power or more, (motor and steam endorsement preferred) or equivalent.
  2. A minimum of 2 years’ experience minimum as Maintenance Superintendent or Operations Office based equivalent.
  3. Experience and knowledge of Safety Management in hydrocarbon processing operations.
  4. Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utility systems, preferred.
  5. Supervisory experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical/Electrical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment Proficiency in English at a minimum of B2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  6. Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

ON OFFER :

Positions at SBM Offshore offer exposure to industry leading technologies, phenomenal opportunities for career progression and the chance to work alongside some of the industries top talent on the biggest Offshore projects in the world.

We offer excellent salaries and comprehensive benefits packages including but not limited to: Bonus, Health and Dental Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement Plan, Share Options.

GENERAL INFORMATION

A Olist é o sistema operacional do varejo e a parceira número 1 do empreendedor brasileiro.

Como Analista de Planejamento e Performance na Olist, sua missão será gerar, consolidar e analisar dados do negócio para identificar oportunidades de melhorias de processos e apoiar decisões estratégicas para a empresa e seus clientes.

  • Contribuir na otimização de processos, produtividade e planejamento operacional;

O que buscamos

  • Formação superior em engenharia, exatas, administração ou áreas correlatas;

  • Raciocínio lógico, noções de negócios e resolução de problemas;

  • Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de BI e Excel/Google Sheets;

Habilidades adicionais que serão um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de AI (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc);

Nosso processo é remoto, composto por inscrição, entrevista com Gente & Gestão, case, entrevista com liderança e com o diretor da área. Caso necessário, haverá conversa presencial com aviso prévio.

Vialto Partners is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.

Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world, and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.

To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram.

Job Role

This position plays a critical role as the primary contact for employees engaged in assignments, transfers, and relocations, both internationally and domestically. You will liaise with clients, internal teams, and mobility suppliers to provide operational support, efficiently manage inquiries, and address issues related to global mobility. You will ensure compliance with immigration, tax, and labor laws, while optimizing deployment costs and driving process improvements.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the business travel experience for employees, ensuring comprehensive documentation compliance with PWD regulations, including the manual submission of certifications.
  • Function as the central point of contact for mobile employees, providing guidance on mobility processes, policies, taxes, and procedures.
  • Ensure adherence to local, national, and international laws and regulations in each deployment location, including immigration, tax, and labor laws.
  • Collaborate with HR and internal teams to ensure smooth deployment of employees.
  • Maintain budget awareness, optimizing costs while maintaining deployment quality.
  • Partner with third-party providers to streamline deployment processes.
  • Keep detailed records of all process documentation.
  • Provide regular reports and data to senior management on case monitoring, onboarding, and workload.
  • Identify and mitigate risks in workforce deployment.
  • Gather feedback to improve deployment processes and support services.
  • Contribute to automation and process improvements.
  • Coordinate with different territories to handle complex queries and regulations.
  • Serve as a primary contact for traveling employees, ensuring their needs are met and transitions are smooth.
  • Maintain communication with clients regarding travel assessments and concerns.
  • Oversee workforce matters related to business travel, ensuring legal and regulatory compliance.
  • Develop and implement a strategic plan for the posted worker directive aligned with global expansion goals.

Qualifications

  • Interest in Global Taxation and Mobility
  • Willingness to learn about global tax and mobility practices, including tax equalization and compliance.
  • Basic Knowledge of Immigration Laws
  • Familiarity or willingness to learn immigration regulations.
  • Attention to Detail and Risk Awareness
  • Ability to recognize risk indicators and report findings.
  • Team Collaboration Skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills for client and team interactions.
  • Educational background in Taxation, Law, or related fields.

Purpose of the Position

The Medior Tax Analyst will support the tax function in compliance and advisory roles while gaining hands-on experience in various tax matters. To guarantee all tax requirements are being properly and timely covered according to Brazilian legislation. Impact of the Position

The Medior Tax Analyst leads the right tax calculation for indirect and direct tax, ancillary obligation, and transfer pricing to avoid penalties and reputational issues with the Brazilian government. The Medior Tax Analyst plays a supportive role within the tax function that contributes to maintaining compliance and optimizing the company's tax position. By assisting in various tax processes and collaborating with teams, the analyst helps ensure the organization's financial integrity and regulatory adherence.

Para nós, o esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento!

Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, seu lugar é aqui com a gente! Venha fazer parte da #SeleçãoSBF, sempre temos lugar para novos craques.

Principais responsabilidades

Sobre a posição no jogo:

Como Analista de Orçamento de Pessoal , você entrará em campo, com as seguintes atividades:

  • Desenvolver, consolidar e controlar o orçamento de pessoal da área de Supply Chain, considerando salários, benefícios, encargos sociais e outros custos relacionados;
  • Realizar previsões de headcount e análise de variações de custos, identificando desvios em relação ao orçamento aprovado;
  • Realizar provisões de custos e despesas quando necessário, além das rotinas de rateio durante fechamento contábil, a fim de garantir a correta alocação das despesas operacionais por processo;

  • Analyzar os custos de pessoal associados aos diferentes centros de custo dentro do Supply Chain, garantindo a otimização dos recursos;
  • Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos sem comprometer a eficiência e a qualidade das operações;
  • Fornecer informações detalhadas e relatórios financeiros para suporte à tomada de decisões estratégicas de gestão de pessoas no Supply Chain;
  • Colaborar com a área de Recursos Humanos e outras áreas relacionadas para alinhar o orçamento de pessoal com as necessidades operacionais e estratégicas;
  • Garantir que todas as práticas de orçamento de pessoal estejam em conformidade com as políticas internas e a legislação vigente;
  • Preparar documentações e participar de auditorias internas e externas relacionadas ao orçamento de pessoal de Supply Chain;
  • Desenvolver e manter relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de desempenho relacionados ao orçamento de pessoal;
  • Construir materiais executivos para as governanças de MBR e QBR e análises Ad hoc.

Requisitos e habilidades

O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Economia e áreas afins;
  • Vivência em Orçamento de Pessoal;
  • Familiaridade na construção de indicadores;
  • Excel/Google Sheets intermediário, sendo VBA e Macro um diferencial;
  • PowerBI (desejável);
  • SAP (diferencial);
  • Desejável que tenha atuado no varejo ou em empresas da área de logística.

title: Financial Specialist in JoomPro
description:
JoomPro is the first end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. We aspire to create a new level of service in the wholesale purchasing market. We give everyone, anywhere in the world, the opportunity to order goods from factories in China easily and efficiently. After a successful launch in Brazil, we are now expanding to Mexico to bring seamless wholesale trade to new markets.
JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a platform for global shopping; JoomPulse, a data platform that provides analytics and recommendations for marketplace sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. We are looking for a Financial Specialist who will support and gradually assume full responsibility for the financial function of one of JoomPro's legal entities (JoomPro Brazil LTDA ), including the preparation of financial statements, interaction with the accounting and banking departments, as well as participation in the preparation of the Group's consolidated statements.

Prior experience in international companies, strong knowledge of IFRS , and a hands-on, operational mindset are essential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Full financial control for the Brazilian legal entity, including preparation of internal reports and primary documentation;
  • Performing treasury functions for JoomPro: executing bank payments, monitoring incoming funds from clients, recording transactions in reports, and providing documents upon the request from banks or accounting teams;
  • Oversight and collaboration with external accounting providers in Brazil to ensure accurate bookkeeping and timely financial reporting;
  • Communication with internal business departments on matters of financial control and operations;
  • Preparing monthly financial statements for inclusion in the Group’s consolidated reporting;
  • Analyzing and monitoring accounts receivable, and contributing to the optimization of financial processes.

Requirements:

  • Higher education in Finance, Accounting, or Economics;
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in audit and/or accounting;
  • Solid knowledge of IFRS and understanding of international financial consolidation requirements;
  • English proficiency at Intermediate level or higher (for communication with internal teams, foreign banks, and vendors);
  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel ;
  • Experience at a Big Four firm is a strong advantage;
  • High attention to detail, structured thinking, and the ability to work independently.

We are offering

• Compensation & Rewards : base salary and performance-based bonuses, CLT employment
• Office-first : flexible hours with a possibility to work remotely 52 days per year, and 30 days of paid annual leave
• Care & Wellbeing: extended health insurance for the employees, their spouses, and children (including dental care), transportation and daily meal allowance, and 100% paid sick leave
• Team & Growth: collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions, professional trainings, and English courses
• Community & Engagement: annual team building activities, knowledge-sharing workshops, and a strong sense of team work
